title: Implement one-line version-pinned installer
description: Provide a single version-pinned command that installs the prebuilt artifact on supported Ubuntu hosts without source build steps.
acceptanceCriteria: The documented one-line command pins an explicit release version and selects the correct architecture
The command downloads and verifies the artifact, stages it, preserves external mutable data, installs the service, and checks readiness
It never runs `npm ci`, `npm install`, `next build`, or source compilation on the target VPS
An unsupported OS/architecture, missing runtime, checksum failure, or readiness failure produces an actionable nonzero error
A successful install leaves the prior release recoverable

steps.details: Assert the installer help/command path contains explicit version/architecture/checksum behavior and rejects build commands in the target path.
Add a release-install entry point that accepts a pinned tag/version and delegates to the verified artifact deployment path.
Make the documented command retrieve only the installer/release metadata needed, not a full source checkout, unless an explicit development mode is requested.
Run health/readiness after service activation; on failure restore the prior active pointer and report the candidate release as failed.
Use a temporary fixture or dry-run mode to exercise argument parsing and path planning without installing system packages or contacting a real VPS.

technicalNotes: Node.js 22 remains a runtime prerequisite; a zero-build installer must not claim to remove that prerequisite.
